sloka: शतम् शत सहस्राणि दृष्ट्वा वै सेतु बन्धनम् ।गो लान्गूलम् महावेगम् गव अक्षम् नाम यूथपम् ॥६-२७-३३॥।।
transliteration: śatam śata sahasrāṇi dṛṣṭvā vai setu bandhanam ।go lāngūlam mahāvegam gava akṣam nāma yūthapam ॥6-27-33॥।।

translations.english: "These hundred and hundred thousand black monkeys with a tail like that of a cow called Golangulas, endowed with black coloured face, fearsome and with extraordinary strength, watching the bridge constructed, surround Gavaksha the leader, who himself is a Golangula and of great speed. They intend to demolish Lanka with their vigour."
translations.hindi: बहुत सी धूल का बवंडर वह रहा है । ये काले मुख के भयङ्कर महाबली गोलाङ्ग,ल
